en.headline: Sogo reports membership system breach potentially affecting 820000 members
en.dek: The department store said unauthorised access occurred in November, with the Privacy Commissioner investigating after notification on Thursday.
body: Sogo said it discovered in November that unauthorised parties had accessed part of its membership system data. According to the company, the affected information mainly involves some membership numbers, names, contact telephone numbers, email addresses and membership points.

The Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data said it received a data breach notification from the retailer on Thursday. Preliminary information indicated that Sogo found abnormal data access records in its membership system on 5 November. The incident may affect the personal data of about 820,000 members, which may include names, email addresses, telephone numbers and membership point balances. The commissioner has launched an investigation under the established mechanism.

Sogo said it attaches great importance to the incident and has immediately begun a full investigation and follow-up. It has notified the relevant government departments and is fully co-operating with the investigation. The company has taken measures including enhancing network security monitoring, abnormal activity detection, detailed investigation and risk assessment, and continuous system monitoring to prevent similar incidents.

The retailer reminded members to remain vigilant, not to click on unknown links, and not to disclose personal, account or verification information to any party claiming to represent the company. Members who receive suspicious calls, messages or emails should contact the company to verify.

zh.headline: 崇光百貨會員系統遭未授權存取 或影響約82萬名會員資料
zh.dek: 百貨公司表示11月發現會員系統部分資料被未授權人士取得，私隱專員公署周四接獲通報後已展開調查。
body: 崇光百貨表示，今年11月發現會員系統曾遭未經授權人士取得部分資料。根據公司現階段調查結果，受影響資料主要涉及部分會員號碼、姓名、聯絡電話、電郵及會員積分資料。
個人資料私隱專員公署表示，周四接獲相關機構的資料外泄事故通報。初步資料顯示，崇光百貨於11月5日發現其會員系統有不正常的資料讀取紀錄。事故可能影響約82萬名會員的個人資料，當中可能包括姓名、電郵地址、電話號碼及會員積分結餘。公署已根據既定機制就事故展開調查。
崇光百貨表示，高度重視此事件，並已立即展開全面調查及跟進工作，亦已向相關政府部門作出通報，正全力配合有關調查工作。公司已採取多項應變措施，包括提升網絡安全系統監察、異常活動偵測、進行詳細調查及風險評估，以及持續監察系統運作情況，以防止同類事件再次發生。
公司提醒所有會員提高警覺，請勿點擊不明連結，如接獲任何來歷不明、聲稱代表本公司的電話、短訊、電郵或其他可疑查詢，請勿向第三方透露任何個人資料、帳戶資料或驗證資訊，並可與公司聯絡核實。
